findings.summary: AI-N28 repair round, stage 2: ESP32 3-class retrained on the dcm x1000 grid with distillation alpha 1.0 (no distillation) (same recipe, teacher and split as 2026-11-04_run01). Candidate only; not promoted; the registry is unchanged. Its int8 variants V12-V17 were not selected on validation and were never tested.
Trained and evaluated on simulated data only (dcm x1000 grid); no real-machine validation exists.
3 classes (inner_race, normal, outer_race): a ball or cage fault is assigned to one of the 3 known classes; no OOD method catches it (AI-N13).
